reviews.review: I loved Remnant: From the Ashes, so I figured I would like this.  Not at all.  The premise of the game is good but it cant deliver.  The gameplay is terrible, and the controls just dont fit.  I would've loved to play this, but its just too bad to keep going.  Needs a lot more polish and considering its been out for a while now, I doubt that its coming.  Its a shame, looked like a fun game.

Edit: I finished the game out of spite but I still feel the same.

This is pretty unfortunate as this will be the first souls-like game I don't finish. Not because it's too hard (I have beaten every souls, sekiro, both surges, lords of the fallen, nioh, darksiders 3 etc.). It's just not any fun at all. The developers here seem to confuse challenge and rewarding difficulty with aggravating unplayability and there isn't much to learn from each death other than that you will never have enough stamina and stability to dodge bullet spray from a dozen enemies at once. The game is a good attempt, they at least deserve credit for that. The main problems don't occur until much later in the game too. Early on you can dodge most things with melee enemies and some gun enemies. Late in the game though they become obsessed with spawning large numbers of enemies at a time who can all teleport every few seconds so you can never get any meaningful damage in while they spam grenades that deal 80% of your health, automatically stun lock you so you always die, and have aoe too large to dodge out of completely, while the room gets filled with random bullet spray that takes RNG to dodge because you can't do it with skill (there's simply too much), while you are permanently slowed by 90%, with traps all over the place. The rewarding aspect of the difficulty in other souls-like games is that you can learn something about enemy behavior and tactics from every death. This just sticks you in tight spaces with aoe spam and bullet spray everywhere and calls it a day. It feels cheap and lazy and falls into the blatant misunderstanding of "if you die a lot it's hard, and if it's hard it's fun." Ya, I can probably finish and beat the game but why would I? This just isn't fun and if I succeed it won't be because I got better and overcame the challenge by learning. If I win it will be because I bashed my head against a brick wall for long enough and got lucky and I have better things to do like shave my head with a belt sander.
